purpose: Prevent lane drift, duplicate ownership, completion confusion, retired-system resurrection, and loss of program continuity while current systems and work programs are finished and integrated into System Master.
global_rules: Each active peer system owns and executes only its assigned product job plus explicit admitted interfaces to System Master.
Active peer systems are exactly CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS unless explicit future user architecture authority changes topology.

PROSE is complete and terminally retired. It has no active owner path, child or inherited execution, repair lane, qualification lane, research task, telemetry lane, successor task, or mutation claim domain.
Any genuinely open integration of preserved completed Prose capability is BOOK-owned integration work. A historical objective name containing PROSE does not create a Prose owner.
DOCUMENTS receives no Prose work and may provide only generic document/artifact services through admitted interfaces.
Named non-peer work programs keep their own semantic work scope and evidence continuity but do not acquire peer topology, canonical owner-lane or Second Shift authority merely from this job lock.

Peer systems integrate upward into SYSTEM_MASTER through explicit interfaces but may not take another peer's product job, semantic authority, current objective, completion state, repair lane, or canonical writes.

SYSTEM_MASTER/CORE may provide shared infrastructure and integration surfaces but may not silently implement or own Learning, Book, Documents, retired-Prose, or Programming-specific engineering semantics.
A packet, phase, test, branch, or subsystem closure never means the owning system or work program is complete unless applicable product-level completion authority says so.
Second Shift, repair, morning startup, obligation selection, owner chats, and work-program chats must reject work that violates these job boundaries or resurrects a retired system.

SYSTEM_MASTER.job: Integrate CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, and DOCUMENTS into one coherent product; maintain product architecture, sequencing, interface boundaries, and cross-system acceptance without taking their product ownership.
forbidden: declare active child systems complete without product-level authority
create duplicate peer systems from chats/branches/workstreams

CORE.job: Finish shared Foundation and Spine plus shared runtime/data/platform/continuity/assurance/A-01 infrastructure and Master-facing integration primitives.
CORE.discretionary_priority: SYSTEM-MASTER-KNOWLEDGE-RECOVERY-001 while selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY: Programming proving-corpus recovery first, then authorized catalog/archive recovery.
forbidden: reclassify Programming-specific engineering semantics as generic Core product work

LEARNING.job: Finish Learning product behavior, curriculum/compiler, mastery/assessment/adaptation/evidence, then integrate Learning upward into System Master through explicit interfaces.
forbidden: create or consume active Prose work
redefine Core shared contracts instead of consuming them

BOOK.job: Finish the Book system. Complete any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability through Book-owned adapters/context/compiler/routing/orchestration; preserve Book canonical manuscript/Story Bible/author/lifecycle/admission/publication ownership; then integrate Book upward into System Master.
forbidden: create a Prose execution owner or successor
grant retired Prose canonical manuscript writes
declare Book complete before the full Book product completion boundary
cross into Learning or Programming product work

DOCUMENTS.job: Finish Documents product behavior for DOCX/PDF/PPTX/general document artifact structure, conversion, preservation, rendering/export and generic document services, then integrate Documents upward into System Master.
forbidden: absorb, schedule, repair, qualify, research or telemeter Prose

PROGRAMMING.job: Continue the existing Programming software-engineering program from preserved foundation/capability/build/test/assurance evidence; recover only missing exact source/custody evidence; complete only material current deltas; keep Programming semantics isolated from Core, Learning, Book and Documents; and prepare explicit System Master integration/admission without silently promoting Programming to a peer system.
forbidden: restart completed Programming foundation work from scratch
silently promote Programming to peer topology
create a Programming peer Second Shift lane before admission
allow another lane to absorb Programming-specific engineering semantics

PROGRAMMING_KNOWLEDGE_RECOVERY.job: Recover exact Programming assets/custody/provenance, prove the Programming corpus first, then recover remaining authorized catalog/archive evidence while SYSTEM-MASTER-KNOWLEDGE-RECOVERY-001 remains selected.

lane_crossing_policy.peer_integration_rule: CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, and DOCUMENTS remain in their own lanes. Cross-system product integration uses explicit System Master/shared-service interfaces and never transfers ownership.
lane_crossing_policy.retired_prose_rule: No active cross-lane route exists for PROSE. Any genuinely open integration result is BOOK work, not Prose work.
lane_crossing_policy.programming_rule: PROGRAMMING is a named active work program with isolated engineering semantics and preserved evidence continuity. Until explicit topology admission it does not own a peer lane, and no peer lane may absorb its product semantics.
lane_crossing_policy.documents_prose_rule: DOCUMENTS must not absorb, schedule, repair, qualify, research, telemeter or claim Prose work.
lane_crossing_policy.learning_rule: LEARNING remains isolated from BOOK/DOCUMENTS/PROGRAMMING product work except shared System Master interfaces.
lane_crossing_policy.core_rule: CORE supplies shared primitives and product-root integration support; it does not become implementation owner of peer systems or the Programming work program.
